text:
Is bebe the desayuno… Húmeda earth

of cementerio huele to sangre amada.

Ciudad of invierno… The mordaz cruzada

of a carreta that arrastrar parece

a emoción of ayuno encadenada!


Is quisiera tocar all the puertas,

and preguntar for not sé quién; and luego

ver to the pobres, and, llorando quedos,

dar pedacitos of pan fresco to all.

And saquear to the ricos their viñedos

with the dos hands santas

that to a golpe of light

volaron desclavadas of the Cruz!


Pestaña matinal, not os levantéis!

¡The pan nuestro of each day dánoslo,

Señor…!


All mis huesos are ajenos;

I talvez the robé!

I vine to darme it that acaso estuvo

asignado for another;

and pienso that, si not hubiera nacido,

another pobre tomara this café!

I soy a mal ladrón… To dónde iré!


And in this hora fría, in that the earth

trasciende to polvo humano and is tan sad,

quisiera I tocar all the puertas,

and suplicar to not sé quién, perdón,

and hacerle pedacitos of pan fresco

here, in the horno of my heart…!

translation.title: The pan nuestro

Translation staged from the supplied local text; no separate editorial review was performed.
